title: gtp: alternative GSN address decoders
description:
All fields with GSN address were decodes as common hf_gsn_addr. But if ETSI order is used, it's possible to specify alternative decoder depending on message type and field position. Alternative decoder for GSN address was added for mandatary fields and optional/conditional field in the case there is single GSN address in message.

Closes #15538

(cherry picked from commit 88657fd5, with additional corrections)
